title: Family pack 48 Miles Helicopter Tour over Theme Parks & Downtown
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Helicopter tour (duration based on option selected)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Arrival time: passengers must arrive 10 to 15 minutes prior to their scheduled departure. If you do not arrive within the specified timeframe, please contact us.
A minimum of 4 people per booking is required

Reschedule/Cancellation Policy: A full refund or reschedule requires at least 24 hours in advance of the start date of the experience. No refunds will be given after that time period. Although all flight times are approximate and subject to change due to weather conditions and weight restrictions. If it is cancelled due to inclement weather (heavy rain, low cloud ceilings, lightning, or extreme winds), you will be offered a different date or a full refund.
Infants up to 2 years old (under 30lb/14kg) must sit on a lap and will fly for free.
We require all the Adults' passengers IDs (drivers license or passports)

Weight restrictions: One person CANNOT exceed 380lbs (172kg) and the total weight for 4 people is 700lbs (317kg). We will do a weight and balance prior to flight then all passengers must be willing to be weighed for safety purposes.
policies: It is a private helicopter tour! You will not be sharing the helicopter with other tour passengers.
Failure in showing up for your appointment without notice will result in cancellation of your tour without refund.
People per ride: The helicopter fits upt to 4 passengers at a time
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Family of 4pax 30 minutes Day or After hours Tour (48 Miles) - On this tour you'll go over all the theme parks & Downtown Orlando!!

You will go over Aquatica, Orlando Eye, ICON Park, Epic Universe (new park), Universal Studios, Island of Adventures, Volcano Bay, Downtown Orlando, Disney Springs, Typhoon Lagoon, Epcot (corner), Hollywood Studios, ESPN Sports Complex, Old Town and Fun Spot Kissimmee. You may also catch a glimpse of Magic Kingdom. 
It is a private helicopter tour! You will not be sharing the helicopter with other tour passengers. 

Bell 206 helicopter accommodates up to 4 passengers at a time. It offers a more comfortable experience with extra space and legroom. Its design also ensures a quieter ride, making for a more relaxing tour, particularly for those sensitive to engine noise. With less vibration, the flight is typically smoother, adding to the overall enjoyment of the experience. The Bell 206 can also hold a heavier passenger seat weight. Inquire for details.
